title: Real NVDA screen-reader gate and ACCESS-006 verification
acceptance: scripts/screen-reader-smoke.ps1 runs a real NVDA session with the Speech Viewer, drives the shell and AcroForm widgets, and asserts the spoken names/roles/values; it fails closed when NVDA is absent; ACCESS-006 is verified on the gui host with the screen-reader evidence and the app tree tests; the accessibility docs and user guide reflect the result.
notes: Stream C of the post-0.1.4 close-out. NVDA 2026.3 portable is under target/tools (untracked); the script resolves PDFXI_NVDA, the portable copy, installed paths, or PATH.
